mapper.select: SELECT user_id as "userId", staff_no as "staffNo", username, password_hash as "passwordHash", system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", use_yn as "useYn" FROM user_account WHERE username = #{username} AND use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT s.session_id as "sessionId", s.user_id as "userId", u.username FROM session s JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND u.use_yn='Y' AND u.system_use_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session(session_id, user_id, status, expires_at, last_accessed_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, 'ACTIVE', #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE session SET last_accessed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
UPDATE session SET status='LOGGED_OUT', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT role_code FROM user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND use_yn='Y' AND valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY role_code

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id as "menuId", m.parent_menu_id as "parentMenuId", m.menu_level as "menuLevel", m.display_order as "displayOrder", m.menu_name as "menuName", m.screen_id as "screenId", m.url, m.icon, m.business_type as "businessType", m.description, m.active_yn as "activeYn" FROM menu m JOIN menu_permission p ON p.menu_id=m.menu_id AND p.target_type='ROLE' AND p.access_allowed_yn='Y' AND p.explicit_deny_yn='N' AND p.use_yn='Y' JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_code=p.target_id AND ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ur.use_yn='Y' AND ur.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (ur.valid_to IS NULL OR ur.valid_to >= CURRENT_DATE) WHERE m.use_yn='Y' AND m.active_yn='Y' ORDER BY m.menu_level, m.parent_menu_id, m.display_order
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET system_use_yn=#{systemUseYn}, change_reason=#{changeReason}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}

UPDATE user_role SET use_yn='N', valid_to=COALESCE(valid_to, CURRENT_DATE), change_reason=#{changeReason}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND assignment_type='MANUAL' AND use_yn='Y'

mapper.update: UPDATE organization SET parent_organization_code=#{parentOrganizationCode}, effective_start_date=#{effectiveStartDate}, effective_end_date=#{effectiveEndDate}, relation_change_reason=#{relationChangeReason}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE organization_code=#{organizationCode}
mapper.select: SELECT role_code as "roleCode", role_name as "roleName", purpose, grant_criteria as "grantCriteria", data_scope_default as "dataScopeDefault", use_yn as "useYn" FROM role role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') OR role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') ORDER BY role_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role(role_code,role_name,purpose,grant_criteria,data_scope_default,use_yn) VALUES(#{roleCode},#{roleName},#{purpose},#{grantCriteria},#{dataScopeDefault},COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y')) ON CONFLICT(role_code) DO UPDATE SET role_name=EXCLUDED.role_name,purpose=EXCLUDED.purpose,grant_criteria=EXCLUDED.grant_criteria,data_scope_default=EXCLUDED.data_scope_default,use_yn=EXCLUDED.use_yn,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET role_name=#{param2.roleName}, purpose=#{param2.purpose}, grant_criteria=#{param2.grantCriteria}, data_scope_default=#{param2.dataScopeDefault}, use_yn=COALESCE(#{param2.useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_code=#{roleCode}
mapper.select: SELECT user_role_id as "userRoleId", user_id as "userId", role_code as "roleCode", assignment_type as "assignmentType", valid_from as "validFrom", valid_to as "validTo", approved_by as "approvedBy", use_yn as "useYn" FROM user_role AND user_id=#{userId} AND role_code=#{roleCode} AND assignment_type=#{assignmentType} AND valid_from <= CAST(#{validOn} AS date) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= CAST(#{validOn} AS date)) ORDER BY user_id, role_code, valid_from DESC

SELECT user_role_id as "userRoleId", user_id as "userId", role_code as "roleCode", assignment_type as "assignmentType", valid_from as "validFrom", valid_to as "validTo", approved_by as "approvedBy", use_yn as "useYn" FROM user_role WHERE user_role_id=#{userRoleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_role SET valid_to=#{validTo}, use_yn='N', change_reason=#{changeReason}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_role_id=#{userRoleId}
mapper.select: SELECT menu_id as "menuId", parent_menu_id as "parentMenuId", menu_level as "menuLevel", display_order as "displayOrder", menu_name as "menuName", screen_id as "screenId", url, icon, business_type as "businessType", description, active_yn as "activeYn" FROM menu WHERE use_yn='Y' ORDER BY menu_level, parent_menu_id NULLS FIRST, display_order

mapper.select: SELECT permission_id as "permissionId", target_type as "targetType", target_id as "targetId", menu_id as "menuId", access_allowed_yn as "accessAllowedYn", explicit_deny_yn as "explicitDenyYn" FROM menu_permission use_yn='Y' AND target_type=#{targetType} AND target_id=#{targetId} AND menu_id=#{menuId} ORDER BY target_type,target_id,menu_id

mapper.select: SELECT group_id as "groupId", code_value as "codeValue", code_name as "codeName", parent_code_value as "parentCodeValue", sort_order as "sortOrder", extra_attributes as "extraAttributes", use_yn as "useYn", valid_from as "validFrom", valid_to as "validTo" FROM detail_code group_id=#{groupId} AND code_value=#{codeValue} AND code_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{codeName}, '%') AND parent_code_value=#{parentCodeValue} AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY sort_order, code_value
